groups.name: Text hierarchy light surfaces (natural-50 / warm / soft)
groups.note: Every ratio below is measured against natural-50 (#FBF6F3) and must hold at natural-100 (#F1EBE4) too, which is the darker of the two light surfaces. Kickers and "secondary" were both below AA here until the 2026-08 audit; they are text, not decoration, so 4.5:1 is the floor. Kicker ocean-500 8.3:1 AAA signpost label. Was ocean-400 (3.3:1). Heading ocean-600 9.9:1 AAA max for light bg, main message. Body ocean-500 8.3:1 AAA content, clearly below heading in tone. Secondary grey-green-600 5.8:1 AA captions, meta, supporting copy. Muted grey-green-300 decorative / disabled never for reading text. Text hierarchy dark surfaces (brand / inverse, ocean-900 bg): Heading white 12.5:1 AAA maximum brightness, anchors the section. Body ocean-100 9.6:1 AAA content, clear step down from white. Secondary ocean-200 7.3:1 AAA supporting copy, labels, nav.

groups.name: Accent words
groups.note: Brand/inverse *surfaces* swap them to ocean-300 (see layout/sections.css); a surface that is neither a photograph, say reclaims the vivid lime via --color-text-accent-brand, which is legible because it sits on dark imagery rather than on cream. On light surfaces the accent is ocean-500, not a green. Any lime dark enough to clear AA on cream stops reading as the brand lime and starts reading as olive, so rather than ship a muddy compromise the accent role switches family: blue on light, green on dark. This is the split the lime ramp in primitives.css has always described "pair with ocean-700/800 as background" now enforced rather than merely documented. This is the rule the lime ramp in primitives.css has always documented; --color-text-accent is where it is now actually enforced.

groups.name: Type scale THE site type scale
groups.note: Every text element on the site resolves to one of these roles; component CSS never sets a raw font-size / line-height / letter-spacing. Change a role here and it changes everywhere. display-hero page H1 (hero) ~88 → 64 → 56px section-heading section H2 48 → 28px card-heading subheading / large card name 38 → 24px title card & step titles 26 → 20px title-small small titles, FAQ questions 18px body-large ledes, intros 18 → 16px body running copy 16px body-small secondary copy, UI text 14px label / meta kickers, tags, metadata 14px semibold caption fine print, micro labels 12px Responsive steps are re-pointed in the @media blocks at the bottom.
